title: Three fixed points on the symplectic quadric threefold
summary: We construct a smooth Hamiltonian diffeomorphism of the complex quadric threefold with exactly three fixed points, at least one of which is degenerate. The critical number and the unit-inclusive rational cup length of this manifold are both four. Thus the example disproves the unrestricted critical-number and rational cup-length forms of the Arnold conjecture.
family_title: Counterexamples to stable-Morse and strong Arnold fixed-point bounds

review.reason: Constructs a Hamiltonian diffeomorphism of the quadric threefold with exactly three fixed points.
